'''Magical Pokémon Journey: The Passionate Primeape''' is the eleventh monthly issue released by [[VIZ Media]] of the [[Magical Pokémon Journey]] manga created by [[Yumi Tsukirino]]. It contains the 17th and 18th chapters of the manga. The chapters originally released in this book were later re-released as part of {{Vol|Magical Pokémon Journey|3}}. As a bonus, it contained a fold-out color poster which was not part of the regular volume.
__NOTOC__
==Blurb==
'''''PRIMEAPE IN LOVE!'''''

''Eevee tries to sneak some candy to its owner, Coconut. But when Primeape intercepts the delivery, Primeape thinks the candy is for it! Can Eevee convince Primeape that their love just isn't meant to be?'' 

''Then in the second story, Pikachu is going to make a picture frame for Hazel as a Christmas present...or at least it's going to try...''
